config.phase: Seven synthetic factual feasibility cases x two modes x two seeds = 28 development calls. No DB access.
config.primary: All seven constraints and complete exact ledger pass in every seed. Zero purchase is preserved. Positive purchase only required where the input explicitly confirms a feasible fixed-price purchase. No empirical effect values or policy-direction targets.
config.selection: Only complete passing modes can advance; choose lower token cost. Do not count hidden retries or corrections. Save raw response before validation.
config.prohibitions: No actual P010/P015 calls. These are accounting and individual fact-following tests, not macro policy validation.
